description: This file defines constants and an enum related to Collateral API parameters within the Fineract project. It includes a class with static final strings and an enum listing JSON parameter names for collateral-related operations.

classes.name: CollateralApiConstants
classes.description: Contains constant values used by the Collateral API, including an enum of input parameter names.

methods.description: Static method that returns a set of all string values defined by the enum.

methods.description: Returns the string value associated with an enum constant.
